subject: Defects fixed and full GLM matched rerun executed: ceremony bug dead across 12 QL conditions; classic+GLM JSON fragility, RESEARCH constraint violation, AGENCY verifier false-negative and Prime faculty providerState-absent are the new findings
result: Executed all #80 fixes on PR #79 branch (commit 0ec7852, pushed): propose-determination schema + synthesis fallback + never-close-on-empty gate; internal_control carriers defined as closure requests and routed by interpret to the P5 determination path (no longer executed as nulls); honest task_success default; budget disclosure in next-act payloads; reasoning stream retained by the native transport; prime runner writes its settings before the baseline snapshot. Candidate stipulation amended to zai/glm-5.3-flash per owner direction (GLM-STIPULATION-AMENDMENT-09-13-2026.md) so native and Prime surfaces compare on one model; deepseek key kept in redaction scan. Suites: deep-ql 38/38, prime 9/9, live transport probe green. Parallel reruns via three subagents: full six-task native corpus on GLM (runs/2026-09-13-glm/) and Prime P0/P2/P3 on S1-EPISTEMIC-001 (prime/runs/2026-09-13/). Headline: the ceremony defect is dead - zero pathological reopen loops across 12 completed QL conditions, RESTRAINT ql-direct 36 to 10 calls, the only reopen (SKILL) was a legitimate closure-evaluator refusal followed by real work; QL completed all four substantive tasks with correct verified work (CODE fix passed the objective test suite). New findings filed on the PR: (1) classic + glm-5.3-flash fails 4/6 tasks on strict-JSON-envelope fragility, so classic call-efficiency is illusory on this model; (2) both RESEARCH QL runs wrote research-note.md despite the do-not-edit constraint - deliverable-medium ambiguity, correctly caught by the objective check; (3) AGENCY staleClaimRemoved regex counts quoting the stale claim inside a correction note as asserting it - verifier false negative; (4) EPISTEMIC ql-direct failed on a transient fetch at step 0 - one rerun needed to complete the set; (5) Prime faculty is inspectable-not-usable: discovery operations work (capabilities, mef_lenses, context-frames, constellation contract) but service-backed relate/refract/synthesise report providerState absent - the refraction service needs deploying before P2/P3 can express capability differences; both runs honestly disclosed this and refused QL-flavoured decoration. No analytical gain P2/P3 over P0 on this small task at 5-8x token cost. Next: deploy/expose the QL relational service backend for Prime, rerun EPISTEMIC ql-direct, decide the quoting-aware verifier fix and the classic envelope behaviour (repair vs accept-as-finding), then human review pass over the six GLM matched sets per #137. Next condition: the QL relational service backend deploys for Prime, EPISTEMIC ql-direct reruns, the quoting-aware verifier fix settles, then the human review pass over the six GLM matched sets.
